title: C2MS에 L1 손실과 분광 손실을 함께 적용
hypothesis: Experiment 58 (MSE + 0.01 x spectral loss) lowered QB SAM by 0.048 deg but failed RR2 on QB. Experiment 63 (L1 instead of MSE) shows much better coarse-scale validation (PSNR +0.15 to +0.48 dB by epoch 74). Combining L1 with the same spectral loss may keep the coarse scale (RR2) while adding the spectral-loss SAM gain.

arms.C2MS_L1S: unchanged C2MS architecture; original L1 + 1.0 x coarse L1 + 0.46 x spectral loss (mean 1 - cosine) on the original pair; 58 trainer with its MSE expressions replaced by absolute errors

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained models evaluated on the WV2 test set (PanCollection convention; WV2 has no training data)

precision: FP16 AMP core training; FP32 transforms/loss/validation/evaluation
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch0; earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as C2MS)
loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss (58: mean over pixels of 1 - cos between predicted and GT band vectors, zero-norm pixels skipped) on the original pair; history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors
sensor_operators: 54 prepare.py SENSORS (QB, GF2, WV3; WV2 for the transfer test), phase 2

judgement.criteria: docs/judgement_criteria.md v2.3 against the same-seed 53 C2MS; single seed noise threshold 0.06 dB, 0.04 dB for 2+ seeds
judgement.sam_goal: QB dSAM <= -0.15 deg (first) / <= -0.28 deg (stretch) with dPSNR >= -0.04 dB, reported separately
judgement.reported_only: FR QNR, D_lambda, D_s; coarse validation

limits: spectral weight 0.46 matches the 58 gradient ratio at the converged C2MS output; early in training the L1/MSE gradient ratio differs

constraints.training: user authorized on 2026-10-26, to start after experiment 64 on the server (watcher)

control_policy: No new control run. The official control is the archived 53 C2MS of the same seed: a same-seed C2MS retrained in 57 differed from it by only +0.009 dB / -0.003 deg / -0.004 on RR, but by -0.306 dB on RR2 and 1.124 in the observation ratio. The 57 retrained C2MS is reported as a second reference; RR2/observation guards that fail against 53 but pass against 57 are read as run-to-run variance. If the 3-seed guards end within 0.02 dB of a tolerance, same-code 3-seed controls are added.

stages.screen: QB seed 42, scheduled on 2026-10-26 by the user to start automatically after experiment 64 finishes (or fails to start) on the server
stages.screen_gate: test RR SAM <= -0.05 deg and RR PSNR >= -0.04 dB against the 53 control, or a single-seed v2.3 improvement, with validation in the same direction -> QB seeds 43 and 44
stages.expansion: GF2/WV3 seeds 42-44 and the WV2 transfer only if the QB 3-seed result is an improvement or meets the SAM goal, after user approval

ema: EMA (beta 0.99) recorded as in 58, reported only; the main result uses the validation-MSE-selected regular weights
comparison_note: the L1-only run of experiment 63 (QB seed 42) is compared afterwards from its per-scene records on the same 20 scenes, to separate the spectral-loss effect under L1
spectral_weight_rule: fixed before training (user choice on 2026-10-26: same relative strength as 58): lambda = 0.01 x |grad L1| / |grad MSE| with respect to the converged 53 C2MS output on 256 evenly spaced QB training patches (8 batches of 32, local CPU); ratio 46.0 -> 0.4601, per batch 0.43-0.49; record in provenance/spectral_weight_calibration.json

stage1_record.note: QB seed 42 screen (2026-10-26 14:13-17:46 KST); sealed copy in provenance/run_records/runtime_config.json

stage2.approved: 2026-10-26 by the user after the seed 42 screen (test gate passed, validation PSNR 0.005 dB short of the gate)
stage2.judgement: paired 3-seed v2.3 against the 53 C2MS of seeds 42-44 (seed 42 from the stage-1 runtime), noise threshold 0.04 dB; 58 C2MS_SAM (MSE + 0.01 spectral) of seeds 43/44 as reference
stage2.code_change: evaluate.py/run.py accept <seed> in control and reference paths; training code unchanged

stage2_record.note: QB seeds 43 and 44 (2026-10-26 18:03 to 2026-10-27 01:09 KST); sealed copy in provenance/stage2/run_records/runtime_config.json

stage3.approved: 2026-10-27 by the user (expansion gate not met: QB 3-seed partial improvement, SAM -0.100 deg short of the -0.15 deg goal)
stage3.transfer: WV2 test with the WV3-trained models
stage3.order: per seed: GF2 then WV3 (seed 42, 43, 44), each run evaluated right after its training
stage3.spectral_weight: 0.46 for every sensor (the QB recipe unchanged, as 58 kept 0.01 for every sensor); the L1/MSE gradient ratio was calibrated on QB only
stage3.judgement: per sensor, paired 3-seed v2.3 against the same-seed 54 C2MS (RR2 against the same-seed 54 C2MS: the fixed RR2 reference is QB only), noise threshold 0.04 dB; 58 C2MS_SAM (MSE + 0.01 spectral) of the same seed as reference
stage3.code_change: run.py evaluates each run right after its training; training and evaluation code unchanged
